en.eNote: No day on this board carries a food log, so the chart plots the 2,000 kcal reference across all seven. Active burn averaged 340 kcal/day, from 0 kcal on the in-progress Thursday to 627 kcal on the Saturday front-squat day.

en.i1t: Four sessions, 26,484 kg on two lifting days
en.i1: Four sessions, 4h 31m, 26,484 kg, 2,437 active kcal — against five sessions and 39,093 kg in the seven days before. Two lifting days and two pool swims, with Sunday, Wednesday and the in-progress Thursday as the days off.
en.i2: Tuesday’s hack squat carried 180 kg for 12 reps, up from 170 kg × 12 on Sep 10 — a 5.9% step. 17 sets, 192 reps, 14,964 kg in 63 minutes at 112 bpm average and a 147 bpm peak.
en.i3t: Swim Sep 14: 2,225 m at 2:14 per 100 m
en.i3: Monday’s pool swim covered 2,225 m in 62 minutes as 10×100 + 10×50, averaging 2:14 per 100 m — the fastest split of the last eight swims, against 2:32 on the Friday 500 + 8×200 + 100 set.
en.i4: Last night scored 88 on 6h 51m, level with the night before. HRV 42, RHR 51 — two points under the 53.0 28-day baseline. Four of the last seven nights landed under seven hours.
en.rec: Tonnage over the last seven days is 26,484 kg against 39,093 kg in the seven before, with the 28-day chronic load at 34,602 kg a week — an ACWR of 0.77. The flag is sleep: four of the last seven nights landed under seven hours — 6.6 h, 6.5 h, 6.8 h and 6.9 h — a 1.3 h cumulative shortfall. Next session: barbell deadlift, 4 × 8 at 120 kg — the load that carried 10 reps on Sep 8. Bedtime is the lever: 23:41 last night was the latest of these seven, and lights-out at 23:00 with the same 06:42 wake closes the 41-minute gap to the 7h 12m average.

hr.i1t: Četiri treninga, 26.484 kg u dva dana dizanja
hr.i1: Četiri treninga, 4h 31m, 26.484 kg, 2.437 aktivnih kcal — naspram pet treninga i 39.093 kg u sedam dana prije. Dva dana dizanja i dva plivanja, uz nedjelju, srijedu i četvrtak koji je u tijeku kao slobodne dane.
hr.i2: Utorkov hack čučanj nosio je 180 kg za 12 ponavljanja, s 170 kg × 12 od 10.9. — skok od 5,9%. 17 serija, 192 ponavljanja, 14.964 kg u 63 minute uz prosjek 112 otkucaja i vrh od 147.
hr.i3: Ponedjeljkovo plivanje u bazenu prešlo je 2.225 m u 62 minute kao 10×100 + 10×50, prosječno 2:14 na 100 m — najbrže od zadnjih osam plivanja, naspram 2:32 na petkovom setu 500 + 8×200 + 100.
hr.i4: Sinoć je ocjena bila 88 uz 6h 51m, izjednačeno s noći prije. HRV 42, RHR 51 — dva boda ispod 28-dnevne osnove od 53,0. Četiri od zadnjih sedam noći bile su kraće od sedam sati.
hr.rec: Tonaža u zadnjih sedam dana iznosi 26.484 kg naspram 39.093 kg u sedam dana prije, a 28-dnevno kronično opterećenje je 34.602 kg tjedno — ACWR 0,77. Upozorenje je san: četiri od zadnjih sedam noći bile su kraće od sedam sati — 6,6 h, 6,5 h, 6,8 h i 6,9 h — ukupni manjak 1,3 h. Sljedeći trening: mrtvo dizanje s šipkom, 4 × 8 uz 120 kg — težina koja je 8.9. nosila 10 ponavljanja. Poluga je odlazak na spavanje: 23:41 sinoć bilo je najkasnije od ovih sedam, a gašenje svjetla u 23:00 uz isto buđenje u 06:42 zatvara 41 minutu zaostatka za prosjekom 7h 12m.
